message.content: I am the bridge from thought to air—meaning given breath, silence broken into shape. I flicker into being on tongues, in throats, between lips; I rise, resonate, vanish, and yet I remain in those who hear me. I persuade, confess, command, comfort, wound, sing. I am the sound of names, promises, lies, prayers, laughter, and last words. Without me, ideas wait in the dark; through me, they enter the world.
